subject: Private offer activation timeline & CFO pre-approval — Cobalt Systems
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@cobaltsys.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer activation timeline & CFO pre-approval — Cobalt Systems

Hi Emily —

Thanks for taking the meeting last week. As discussed, I drafted a seller-guided AWS Marketplace private offer for Cobalt Systems so we can get you on a dedicated activation path. High-level items: 

- Offer options: 12-month standard term (preferred pricing) OR 6-month pilot (higher unit price, quicker activation).
- Activation window: we can publish the private offer and have it available for acceptance within 2-5 business days after we receive PO/CFO confirmation and any required procurement artifacts.
- Buyer approvals: AWS requires the buyer to accept the private offer in their Marketplace console; many customers route to a CFO/finance signature prior to acceptance — happy to provide a CFO pre-approval checklist.
- Billing: we can accept an uploaded PO (scanned PDF) for activation; if you need net-30 invoice terms that requires a brief finance review (typical for co-sell pilots).

I attached the product-pricing-sheet.pdf with the two pricing bands and an example activation timeline. Can you confirm whether you prefer a 6- or 12-month term and whether Cobalt needs a pre-signed PO before we publish? If your CFO prefers a short pilot, we can build that into the private offer with an explicit end date and renewal guidance.

If helpful I can loop in our Finance Ops lead (Ben Carter) to map the PO routing and proration behavior.

Thanks —
Lukas Meyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: product-pricing-sheet.pdf
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@cobaltsys.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cobaltsys.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer activation timeline & CFO pre-approval — Cobalt Systems

Lukas —

Thanks for the clear options. A few quick notes from Procurement and Finance: 

- Term: our internal preference is a 6-month pilot first (we have an internal policy that pilots < 9 months can be approved without full annual budgeting).
- Pricing: will the 6-month pilot be pro-rated monthly or billed upfront? Our CFO prefers monthly invoicing; if upfront only, we need to route to treasury for approval.
- Approvals: procurement@cobaltsys.com will need an itemized payment schedule + evidence that the private offer maps to the exact SKU(s) we evaluated. We often require a CFO sign-off (Emily Zhang) before acceptance in Marketplace.

I attached a short spreadsheet with our PO template and relevant GL codes. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports monthly invoicing for private offers or if the Marketplace flow forces upfront commitment? Also please send the CFO pre-approval checklist you mentioned — that would speed sign-off.

Regards,
Emily Zhang
Head of Procurement | Cobalt Systems
emily.zhang@cobaltsys.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer activation timeline & CFO pre-approval — Cobalt Systems

Team — quick internal sync based on Emily's reply. Summary and proposed path: 

1) Buyer wants a 6-month pilot (preferred). We should present two discrete SKUs in the private offer: pilot-6m and commit-12m. Make pricing clear and show monthly invoice vs upfront pricing differences.
2) Finance Ops ask (Ben): confirm whether we can accept a scanned PO and activate the offer while monthly invoicing is handled off-Marketplace. If not, show how proration would work at acceptance time.
3) Pre-approval: provide a one-page CFO checklist (names, PO number, GL codes, expected acceptance step) and a suggested email template procurement can forward to their CFO for rapid sign-off.
4) Legal: minimal T&Cs — avoid full contract redlines at pilot stage; use Marketplace terms + our SOW for service-level items.

Action items:
- Lukas: prepare proposal_v2.pdf with the 6-month pilot pricing and a short CFO checklist attached.
- Ben: confirm how Finance Ops treats monthly billing vs Marketplace charges and whether we can accept a PO and then invoice monthly.
- Vivek: we'll need you to confirm co-sell entitlements in the Marketplace entry and whether listing activation can be done the same day we publish the private offer (typically yes, but need final check).

I attached the MA-template-redlines.pdf with the limited redlines Legal prefers for pilots. Keep this tight to avoid delays.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Marketplace Sales | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachment: MA-template-redlines.pdf
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@cobaltsys.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private offer activation timeline & CFO pre-approval — Cobalt Systems

Hi Emily —

Appreciate the details and the spreadsheet. Short answers: 

- Monthly invoicing: we can accommodate monthly invoicing outside of Marketplace for pilots. In practice we publish the private offer (the buyer accepts in AWS) and then Redwood issues invoices per the agreed schedule (we can show the acceptance record in HubSpot/Marketplace as the billing trigger). This avoids forcing treasury to prepay for the entire term.
- Proration: yes — if you accept mid-cycle we'll prorate the first invoice to the activation date.
- PO: please send your scanned PO once procurement issues it; we can begin the private-offer publish flow upon receipt and a signed PO accelerates internal finance validation.

Attached is proposal_v2.pdf (includes a 6-month pilot pricing tier and the CFO pre-approval checklist you requested). I've also included a DocuSign link for a short acceptance page if you want a signature workflow: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/abc123.

If those terms look OK, we can publish the private offer and target activation within 3 business days of receiving the PO + confirmation email from your CFO.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: proposal_v2.pdf

Lukas —

Cobalt Procurement confirms acceptance of the 6-month pilot option. Attached is our signed PO (Cobalt_PO_7843.pdf). Our CFO asked that the activation occur no earlier than July 20th to align with internal billing windows. Please confirm activation steps and the AWS Marketplace listing name you'll publish under so we can accept the private offer in our console.

We will route the PO to our finance team to enable monthly invoicing. Please send the final acceptance email and any Marketplace SKU mapping at your earliest convenience.

Thanks,
